name: XMP Provenance Analysis
description: Analyzes XMP edit history, software chain, and provenance metadata to detect AI generation tools. Examines CreatorTool, History entries, and software agent signatures.
mechanism: Scans XMP metadata for AI tool signatures, examines edit history chain, and validates software agent entries against known AI and photo editing tools.
parameters:
AI markers: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, ComfyUI, etc.
Photo editors: Photoshop, Lightroom, Capture One, etc.
accuracy: Very High - 90%+ when AI tool signatures are present in XMP data
source: Adobe XMP Specification Part 1-3 (ISO 16684), Dublin Core Metadata Initiative
